doc.title: Tyner McCoy — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

chapter: Cal Massey, Coltrane and the Jazztet
title: First meeting John Coltrane
summary: Tyner recalls meeting Coltrane at about sixteen through Khadijah and Naima, after Coltrane had left Miles and was with the Jazztet circle.

story.theme_name: Playing with Coltrane and the avant-garde

blocks.x: Well, lets talk about your first meeting with John, how old were you and what were the circumstances of that meeting?
Because Khadijah was seventeen or eighteen.
Yeah that’s right, her sister sang in Cal’s band, so I’ve known her a long time.
She introduced him to John, to Coltrane because her and Naima, his wife, were very close, they lived . . . not far.
So you met in a social situation, you met on the bandstand, you met in a club?
I met him through . . . well actually he was with Miles, but I think I met him after when he left Miles.
When he was with the Jazztet.
With Benny Golson and Art Farmer and Addison Farmer and what’s his name that played drums . . . kind of nutty guy-
Lex Humphries, yeah (laughs). Don’t put that in. Erase that please.
(laughs) Why don’t we just say he was idiosyncratic.
Yeah that’s it. That’s the word I was looking for, see he’s articulate, I didn’t know it . . . anyway.
